newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Mining World says to accept takeover bid.
newsitem.headline: Mining World says to accept takeover bid.

text.p: Australian drilling contractor Mining World Ltd said on Tuesday its directors recommended shareholders accept a takeover bid from Canada's Major Drilling Group International Inc.
Earlier this month, Major Drilling made a cash offer of 85 cents per Mining World share through its Australian subsidiary, Major Drilling Australia Pty Ltd.
Mining World said it had been advised by Ernst & Young Corporate Finance that the offer was "fair and reasonable".

"Based on this advise and other factors...particularly the uncertainty regarding future dividends and the need for additional capital, the directors are recommending that in the absence of a higher or better offer, that shareholders should accept the Major Drilling offer," Mining World said.
Mining World also said it now expected losses "close to the high end" of an earlier forecast saying results for the six-months ending June 1997 would be between a breakeven and a loss of A$500,000.
"There are still some unresolved matters relating to the sale of the Argentinean drilling contractor, which could result in additional extraordinary losses", it said.
Mining World shares closed steady at 86 cents on Tuesday.
